definitions.explanation: Foods eaten alongside the staple food (typically rice in Japan). Includes dishes such as fish, meat, vegetables, pickles, and soup that accompany the main grain.

examples.japanese: {給食|きゅうしょく}の{副食品|ふくしょくひん}が{充実|じゅうじつ}している。
examples.english: The side dishes in the school lunch are excellent.

examples.japanese: {副食品|ふくしょくひん}の{値段|ねだん}が{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: The prices of side dish items are going up.

examples.japanese: {栄養|えいよう}バランスを{考|かんが}えて、{主食|しゅしょく}と{副食品|ふくしょくひん}を{組|く}み{合|あ}わせることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It is important to combine staple foods with side dishes while considering nutritional balance.

notes:
Composed of {副|ふく} (supplementary, secondary) + {食品|しょくひん} (food items). In traditional Japanese meal structure, food is divided into {主食|しゅしょく} (staple food, usually rice) and {副食|ふくしょく} (everything else). {副食品|ふくしょくひん} is the formal term for these accompanying items.

JAPANESE MEAL STRUCTURE:
- {主食|しゅしょく}: staple food (rice, noodles, bread)
- {副食|ふくしょく}/{副食品|ふくしょくひん}: side dishes (fish, meat, vegetables)
- {汁物|しるもの}: soup (miso soup, clear soup)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副食品|ふくしょくひん}を{増|ふ}やす: to increase the variety of side dishes
- {副食品|ふくしょくひん}の{栄養|えいよう}: nutrition from side dishes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- おかず: side dishes -- the everyday, casual term
- {副食|ふくしょく}: side dishes -- slightly shorter form, same meaning
- {惣菜|そうざい}: prepared dishes -- ready-made side dishes sold at stores
